response.claim: A card account may be reported past-due to CICs or levied penal charges only when it is past due for more than three days; days-past-due and late charges are computed from the payment due date; late charges apply only to the outstanding amount after the due date, not the Total Amount Due.
response.final_answer: The assessment applies late charges using Total Amount Due, contrary to the requirement that late charges apply only to the outstanding amount after the due date.
